title: Event taxonomy (data/events.json)
description: Every event <brand> reports: the log tab of the hub, notifications at events (rest/event-notifications.json) and the Home Assistant events <ns>_event (all) and <ns>_alarm (alarm kinds). source = who creates it: integration (fires it in Home Assistant itself and sends it to the hub, POST /api/integration/events) or hub (the hub sends ws/integration/ha_event and the integration fires it). Generated as a constant for every language (codegen ContractData).

important.description: Important besides the alarms: the overview of the admin UI ("Recent important") and the log filter important=true (GET /api/log) show entries whose event_kind or kind is marked here, plus every entry of the log category alarm. Only on kinds with alarm false; missing = not important (e.g. a single denied, which is activity).

notify_min_interval_minutes.description: Notifications at events (rest/event-notifications.json) send this kind at most once per device (client_id) and rule in this time; further events within it are bundled into one message at its end (kids_paused_all at most every 15 minutes per child). The log entry and the Home Assistant event <ns>_event are never held back. Missing = no limit of its own (the rule's threshold and bundle_minutes apply).
